name: James Mattis

summary.text: James Mattis, a retired Marine Corps general and U.S. Secretary of Defense from 2017 to 2019, joined the Theranos board of directors after retiring from the military in 2013 and, while at U.S. Central Command, had advocated testing Theranos devices in the field. The SEC's March 2018 fraud complaint against Theranos and Elizabeth Holmes alleged that claims that Theranos products were deployed by the Department of Defense in Afghanistan and on medevac helicopters were false.

facts.claim: Holmes settled the SEC charges by paying a $500,000 penalty, accepting a bar from serving as an officer or director of a public company until 2028, surrendering voting control and returning shares; Ramesh Balwani did not settle, and in June 2018 federal prosecutors in Northern California indicted Holmes and Balwani for wire fraud and conspiracy.
